properties.SQL Query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    MD5(TRIM(b.payment_id::text)) AS payment_hk,
    b.payment_id,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS load_date,
    b.source_system AS record_source
FROM bronze.payment b
WHERE b.payment_id IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.hub_payment h
      WHERE h.payment_id = b.payment_id
  );

SELECT
    MD5(TRIM(b.payment_id::text)) AS payment_hk,

    b.amount,
    b.payment_date,
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.payment_type), '') AS payment_type,
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.status), '') AS status,

    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS load_date,
    b.source_system AS record_source

FROM bronze.payment b

WHERE b.payment_id IS NOT NULL

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.hub_payment h
      WHERE h.payment_hk = MD5(TRIM(b.payment_id::text))
  )

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.sat_payment s
      WHERE s.payment_hk = MD5(TRIM(b.payment_id::text))
        AND s.amount IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.amount
        AND s.payment_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.payment_date
        AND s.payment_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(TRIM(b.payment_type), '')
        AND s.status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(TRIM(b.status), '')
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
    MD5(
        MD5(TRIM(b.customer_id::text))
        || '|'
        || MD5(TRIM(b.payment_id::text))
    ) AS customer_payment_hk,

    hc.customer_hk,
    hp.payment_hk,

    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS load_date,
    b.source_system AS record_source

FROM bronze.payment b

JOIN silver.hub_customer hc
    ON hc.customer_id = b.customer_id

JOIN silver.hub_payment hp
    ON hp.payment_id = b.payment_id

WHERE b.customer_id IS NOT NULL
  AND b.payment_id IS NOT NULL

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.link_customer_payment l
      WHERE l.customer_hk = hc.customer_hk
        AND l.payment_hk = hp.payment_hk
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
    MD5(
        MD5(TRIM(b.customer_id::text))
        || '|'
        || MD5(TRIM(b.rental_id::text))
    ) AS customer_rental_hk,

    hc.customer_hk,
    hr.rental_hk,

    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS load_date,
    b.source_system AS record_source

FROM bronze.rental b

JOIN silver.hub_customer hc
    ON hc.customer_id = b.customer_id

JOIN silver.hub_rental hr
    ON hr.rental_id = b.rental_id

WHERE b.customer_id IS NOT NULL
  AND b.rental_id IS NOT NULL

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.link_customer_rental l
      WHERE l.customer_hk = hc.customer_hk
        AND l.rental_hk = hr.rental_hk
  );

SELECT
    MD5(b.customer_id::text) AS customer_hk,
    b.first_name,
    b.last_name,
    b.email,
    b.phone,
    b.status,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS load_date,
    b.source_system AS record_source
FROM bronze.customer b
WHERE b.customer_id IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.hub_customer h
      WHERE h.customer_hk = MD5(b.customer_id::text)
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.sat_customer s
      WHERE s.customer_hk = MD5(b.customer_id::text)
        AND s.first_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.first_name
        AND s.last_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.last_name
        AND s.email IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.email
        AND s.phone IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.phone
        AND s.status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.status
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
    MD5(
        MD5(TRIM(b.customer_id::text))
        || '|'
        || MD5(TRIM(b.subscription_id::text))
    ) AS customer_subscription_hk,

    hc.customer_hk,
    hs.subscription_hk,

    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS load_date,
    b.source_system AS record_source

FROM bronze.customer_subscription b

JOIN silver.hub_customer hc
    ON hc.customer_id = b.customer_id

JOIN silver.hub_subscription hs
    ON hs.subscription_id = b.subscription_id

WHERE b.customer_id IS NOT NULL
  AND b.subscription_id IS NOT NULL

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.link_customer_subscription l
      WHERE l.customer_hk = hc.customer_hk
        AND l.subscription_hk = hs.subscription_hk
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
    MD5(customer_id::text) AS customer_hk,
    customer_id,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS load_date,
    source_system AS record_source
FROM bronze.customer b
WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.hub_customer h
      WHERE h.customer_id = b.customer_id
  );

SELECT
    MD5(TRIM(b.rental_id::text)) AS rental_hk,

    b.rental_date,
    b.due_date,
    b.return_date,
    b.rental_fee,
    b.late_fee,
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.status), '') AS status,

    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS load_date,
    b.source_system AS record_source

FROM bronze.rental b

WHERE b.rental_id IS NOT NULL

AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM silver.hub_rental h
    WHERE h.rental_hk = MD5(TRIM(b.rental_id::text))
)

AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM silver.sat_rental s
    WHERE s.rental_hk = MD5(TRIM(b.rental_id::text))
      AND s.rental_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.rental_date
      AND s.due_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.due_date
      AND s.return_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.return_date
      AND s.rental_fee IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.rental_fee
      AND s.late_fee IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.late_fee
      AND s.status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(TRIM(b.status), '')
);

SELECT DISTINCT
    MD5(TRIM(b.rental_id::text)) AS rental_hk,
    b.rental_id,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS load_date,
    b.source_system AS record_source
FROM bronze.rental b
WHERE b.rental_id IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.hub_rental h
      WHERE h.rental_id = b.rental_id
  );

SELECT
    MD5(TRIM(b.content_id::text)) AS content_hk,

    NULLIF(TRIM(b.title), '') AS title,
    b.release_date,
    b.duration_minutes,
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.language), '') AS language,
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.age_rating), '') AS age_rating,

    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS load_date,
    b.source_system AS record_source

FROM bronze.content b

WHERE b.content_id IS NOT NULL

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.hub_content h
      WHERE h.content_hk = MD5(TRIM(b.content_id::text))
  )

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.sat_content s
      WHERE s.content_hk = MD5(TRIM(b.content_id::text))
        AND s.title IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(TRIM(b.title), '')
        AND s.release_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.release_date
        AND s.duration_minutes IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.duration_minutes
        AND s.language IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(TRIM(b.language), '')
        AND s.age_rating IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(TRIM(b.age_rating), '')
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
    MD5(TRIM(b.content_id::text)) AS content_hk,
    b.content_id,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS load_date,
    b.source_system AS record_source
FROM bronze.content b
WHERE b.content_id IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.hub_content h
      WHERE h.content_id = b.content_id
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
    MD5(
        hc.content_hk
        || '|'
        || hi.inventory_hk
    ) AS content_inventory_hk,

    hc.content_hk,
    hi.inventory_hk,

    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS load_date,
    b.source_system AS record_source

FROM bronze.inventory_item b

JOIN silver.hub_content hc
    ON hc.content_id = b.content_id

JOIN silver.hub_inventory hi
    ON hi.inventory_id = b.inventory_id

WHERE b.content_id IS NOT NULL
  AND b.inventory_id IS NOT NULL

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.link_content_inventory l
      WHERE l.content_hk = hc.content_hk
        AND l.inventory_hk = hi.inventory_hk
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
    MD5(TRIM(b.subscription_id::text)) AS subscription_hk,
    b.subscription_id,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS load_date,
    b.source_system AS record_source
FROM bronze.customer_subscription b
WHERE b.subscription_id IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.hub_subscription h
      WHERE h.subscription_id = b.subscription_id
  );

SELECT
    MD5(TRIM(b.inventory_id::text)) AS inventory_hk,

    NULLIF(TRIM(b.barcode), '') AS barcode,
    b.purchase_date,
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.item_condition), '') AS item_condition,
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.status), '') AS status,

    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS load_date,
    b.source_system AS record_source

FROM bronze.inventory_item b

WHERE b.inventory_id IS NOT NULL

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.hub_inventory h
      WHERE h.inventory_hk = MD5(TRIM(b.inventory_id::text))
  )

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.sat_inventory s
      WHERE s.inventory_hk = MD5(TRIM(b.inventory_id::text))
        AND s.barcode IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(TRIM(b.barcode), '')
        AND s.purchase_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.purchase_date
        AND s.item_condition IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(TRIM(b.item_condition), '')
        AND s.status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(TRIM(b.status), '')
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
    MD5(TRIM(b.inventory_id::text)) AS inventory_hk,
    b.inventory_id,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS load_date,
    b.source_system AS record_source
FROM bronze.inventory_item b
WHERE b.inventory_id IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM silver.hub_inventory h
      WHERE h.inventory_id = b.inventory_id
  );

processGroups.name: DIMENSIONS
processGroups.comments: Load all Gold dimensions before facts.

properties.SQL Query:
SELECT
    b.genre_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.genre_name), '') AS genre_name
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (genre_id)
        *
    FROM bronze.genre
    WHERE genre_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY genre_id, ingestion_time DESC
) b

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM gold.dim_genre d
    WHERE d.genre_id = b.genre_id
);

SELECT
    c.city_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c.city_name), '') AS city_name,
    co.country_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(co.country_name), '') AS country_name,
    NULLIF(TRIM(co.country_code), '') AS country_code
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (city_id)
        city_id,
        country_id,
        city_name
    FROM bronze.city
    WHERE city_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY city_id, ingestion_time DESC
) c

JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (country_id)
        country_id,
        country_name,
        country_code
    FROM bronze.country
    WHERE country_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY country_id, ingestion_time DESC
) co
    ON co.country_id = c.country_id

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM gold.dim_location dl
    WHERE dl.city_id = c.city_id
      AND dl.country_id = co.country_id
);

SELECT
    w.warehouse_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(w.warehouse_name), '') AS warehouse_name,
    NULLIF(TRIM(c.city_name), '') AS city_name,
    NULLIF(TRIM(co.country_name), '') AS country_name
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (warehouse_id)
        *
    FROM bronze.warehouse
    WHERE warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY warehouse_id, ingestion_time DESC
) w

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (city_id)
        city_id,
        country_id,
        city_name
    FROM bronze.city
    WHERE city_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY city_id, ingestion_time DESC
) c
    ON c.city_id = w.city_id

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (country_id)
        country_id,
        country_name
    FROM bronze.country
    WHERE country_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY country_id, ingestion_time DESC
) co
    ON co.country_id = c.country_id

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM gold.dim_warehouse d
    WHERE d.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
);

SELECT
    h.content_id,
    s.title,
    s.release_date,
    s.duration_minutes,
    s.language,
    s.age_rating
FROM silver.hub_content h

JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        title,
        release_date,
        duration_minutes,
        language,
        age_rating
    FROM silver.sat_content s
    WHERE s.content_hk = h.content_hk
    ORDER BY s.load_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
) s ON TRUE

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM gold.dim_content d
    WHERE d.content_id = h.content_id
);

SELECT
    h.inventory_id,
    s.barcode,
    s.purchase_date,
    s.item_condition,
    s.status
FROM silver.hub_inventory h

JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        barcode,
        purchase_date,
        item_condition,
        status
    FROM silver.sat_inventory s
    WHERE s.inventory_hk = h.inventory_hk
    ORDER BY s.load_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
) s ON TRUE

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM gold.dim_inventory d
    WHERE d.inventory_id = h.inventory_id
);

SELECT
    b.content_type_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.content_type), '') AS content_type
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (content_type_id)
        *
    FROM bronze.content_type
    WHERE content_type_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY content_type_id, ingestion_time DESC
) b

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM gold.dim_content_type d
    WHERE d.content_type_id = b.content_type_id
);

SELECT
    TO_CHAR(d, 'YYYYMMDD')::INT AS date_key,
    d::DATE AS full_date,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM d)::INT AS day,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d)::INT AS month,
    TRIM(TO_CHAR(d, 'Month')) AS month_name,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM d)::INT AS quarter,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d)::INT AS year

FROM generate_series(
    DATE '2020-01-01',
    DATE '2030-12-31',
    INTERVAL '1 day'
) AS d

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM gold.dim_date dd
    WHERE dd.full_date = d::DATE
);

SELECT
    b.plan_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.plan_name), '') AS plan_name,
    b.monthly_fee,
    NULLIF(TRIM(b.video_quality), '') AS video_quality,
    b.max_devices
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (plan_id)
        *
    FROM bronze.subscription_plan
    WHERE plan_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY plan_id, ingestion_time DESC
) b

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM gold.dim_subscription_plan d
    WHERE d.plan_id = b.plan_id
);

SELECT
    h.customer_id,
    b.customer_no,
    s.first_name,
    s.last_name,
    s.status
FROM silver.hub_customer h

JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        first_name,
        last_name,
        status
    FROM silver.sat_customer s
    WHERE s.customer_hk = h.customer_hk
    ORDER BY s.load_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
) s ON TRUE

LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        customer_no
    FROM bronze.customer b
    WHERE b.customer_id = h.customer_id
    ORDER BY b.ingestion_time DESC
    LIMIT 1
) b ON TRUE

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM gold.dim_customer d
    WHERE d.customer_id = h.customer_id
);

SELECT
    (y * 100 + m)::INT AS month_key,
    m::INT AS month,
    TRIM(TO_CHAR(MAKE_DATE(y, m, 1), 'Month')) AS month_name,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM MAKE_DATE(y, m, 1))::INT AS quarter,
    y::INT AS year
FROM generate_series(2020, 2030) AS y
CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, 12) AS m
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM gold.dim_month dm
    WHERE dm.year = y
      AND dm.month = m
);

WITH inventory_base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (i.inventory_id)
        i.inventory_id,
        i.content_id,
        i.warehouse_id,
        i.purchase_date
    FROM bronze.inventory_item i
    WHERE i.inventory_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY i.inventory_id, i.ingestion_time DESC
),

inventory_days AS (
    SELECT
        i.inventory_id,
        i.content_id,
        i.warehouse_id,
        d.full_date
    FROM inventory_base i

    JOIN gold.dim_date d
      ON d.full_date >= i.purchase_date
     AND d.full_date <= CURRENT_DATE
),

daily_rentals AS (
    SELECT
        inventory_id,
        rental_date::date AS activity_date,
        COUNT(*) AS rental_count
    FROM bronze.rental
    WHERE inventory_id IS NOT NULL
      AND rental_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY inventory_id, rental_date::date
),

daily_returns AS (
    SELECT
        inventory_id,
        return_date::date AS activity_date,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count
    FROM bronze.rental
    WHERE inventory_id IS NOT NULL
      AND return_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY inventory_id, return_date::date
),

active_rentals AS (
    SELECT
        id.inventory_id,
        id.full_date,
        COUNT(r.rental_id) AS active_rental_count
    FROM inventory_days id

    LEFT JOIN bronze.rental r
      ON r.inventory_id = id.inventory_id
     AND r.rental_date::date <= id.full_date
     AND (
            r.return_date IS NULL
            OR r.return_date::date > id.full_date
         )

    GROUP BY
        id.inventory_id,
        id.full_date
)

SELECT
    di.inventory_key,
    dd.date_key,
    dc.content_key,
    dw.warehouse_key,

    COALESCE(dr.rental_count, 0)::int
        AS rental_count,

    COALESCE(dret.return_count, 0)::int
        AS return_count,

    CASE
        WHEN ar.active_rental_count = 0 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END::int AS days_available,

    CASE
        WHEN ar.active_rental_count > 0 THEN 100.00
        ELSE 0.00
    END::numeric(5,2) AS utilisation_percentage

FROM inventory_days id

JOIN gold.dim_inventory di
  ON di.inventory_id = id.inventory_id

JOIN gold.dim_date dd
  ON dd.full_date = id.full_date

JOIN gold.dim_content dc
  ON dc.content_id = id.content_id

JOIN gold.dim_warehouse dw
  ON dw.warehouse_id = id.warehouse_id

LEFT JOIN daily_rentals dr
  ON dr.inventory_id = id.inventory_id
 AND dr.activity_date = id.full_date

LEFT JOIN daily_returns dret
  ON dret.inventory_id = id.inventory_id
 AND dret.activity_date = id.full_date

LEFT JOIN active_rentals ar
  ON ar.inventory_id = id.inventory_id
 AND ar.full_date = id.full_date

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM gold.fact_inventory_daily_utilisation f
    WHERE f.inventory_key = di.inventory_key
      AND f.date_key = dd.date_key
);

WITH activity_dates AS (

    -- Streaming activity
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        start_time::date AS activity_date
    FROM bronze.streaming_session
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND start_time IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    -- Rental activity
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        rental_date::date
    FROM bronze.rental
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND rental_date IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    -- Payment activity
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        payment_date::date
    FROM bronze.payment
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND payment_date IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    -- Support activity
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        opened_date::date
    FROM bronze.support_ticket
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND opened_date IS NOT NULL
),

streaming AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        start_time::date AS activity_date,
        COUNT(*) AS streaming_session_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(watch_duration), 0) AS total_streaming_duration
    FROM bronze.streaming_session
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND start_time IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY customer_id, start_time::date
),

rentals AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        rental_date::date AS activity_date,
        COUNT(*) AS physical_rental_count
    FROM bronze.rental
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND rental_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY customer_id, rental_date::date
),

returns AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        return_date::date AS activity_date,
        COUNT(*) AS returned_item_count
    FROM bronze.rental
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND return_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY customer_id, return_date::date
),

payments AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        payment_date::date AS activity_date,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount_spent
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (payment_id)
            payment_id,
            customer_id,
            payment_date,
            amount,
            ingestion_time
        FROM bronze.payment
        WHERE payment_id IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY payment_id, ingestion_time DESC
    ) p
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND payment_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY customer_id, payment_date::date
),

tickets AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        opened_date::date AS activity_date,
        COUNT(*) AS support_ticket_count
    FROM bronze.support_ticket
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND opened_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY customer_id, opened_date::date
),

customer_location AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (ca.customer_id)
        ca.customer_id,
        dl.location_key
    FROM bronze.customer_address ca
    JOIN gold.dim_location dl
      ON dl.city_id = ca.city_id
    WHERE ca.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY ca.customer_id, ca.ingestion_time DESC
),

customer_plan AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (cs.customer_id)
        cs.customer_id,
        dsp.subscription_plan_key
    FROM bronze.customer_subscription cs
    JOIN gold.dim_subscription_plan dsp
      ON dsp.plan_id = cs.plan_id
    WHERE cs.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY cs.customer_id,
             cs.start_date DESC,
             cs.ingestion_time DESC
)

SELECT
    dc.customer_key,
    dd.date_key,
    cl.location_key,
    cp.subscription_plan_key,

    COALESCE(s.streaming_session_count, 0)::int
        AS streaming_session_count,

    COALESCE(s.total_streaming_duration, 0)::int
        AS total_streaming_duration,

    COALESCE(r.physical_rental_count, 0)::int
        AS physical_rental_count,

    COALESCE(rt.returned_item_count, 0)::int
        AS returned_item_count,

    COALESCE(p.total_amount_spent, 0)::numeric(14,2)
        AS total_amount_spent,

    COALESCE(t.support_ticket_count, 0)::int
        AS support_ticket_count

FROM activity_dates a

JOIN gold.dim_customer dc
  ON dc.customer_id = a.customer_id

JOIN gold.dim_date dd
  ON dd.full_date = a.activity_date

LEFT JOIN customer_location cl
  ON cl.customer_id = a.customer_id

LEFT JOIN customer_plan cp
  ON cp.customer_id = a.customer_id

LEFT JOIN streaming s
  ON s.customer_id = a.customer_id
 AND s.activity_date = a.activity_date

LEFT JOIN rentals r
  ON r.customer_id = a.customer_id
 AND r.activity_date = a.activity_date

LEFT JOIN returns rt
  ON rt.customer_id = a.customer_id
 AND rt.activity_date = a.activity_date

LEFT JOIN payments p
  ON p.customer_id = a.customer_id
 AND p.activity_date = a.activity_date

LEFT JOIN tickets t
  ON t.customer_id = a.customer_id
 AND t.activity_date = a.activity_date

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM gold.fact_customer_daily_activity f
    WHERE f.customer_key = dc.customer_key
      AND f.date_key = dd.date_key
);

WITH activity_months AS (

    SELECT
        content_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', start_time)::date AS activity_month
    FROM bronze.streaming_session
    WHERE content_id IS NOT NULL
      AND start_time IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT
        i.content_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', r.rental_date)::date
    FROM bronze.rental r
    JOIN bronze.inventory_item i
      ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    WHERE i.content_id IS NOT NULL
      AND r.rental_date IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT
        content_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', review_date)::date
    FROM bronze.review
    WHERE content_id IS NOT NULL
      AND review_date IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT
        content_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', added_date)::date
    FROM bronze.wishlist
    WHERE content_id IS NOT NULL
      AND added_date IS NOT NULL
),

streams AS (
    SELECT
        content_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', start_time)::date AS activity_month,
        COUNT(*) AS total_streams
    FROM bronze.streaming_session
    WHERE content_id IS NOT NULL
      AND start_time IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        content_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', start_time)::date
),

rentals AS (
    SELECT
        i.content_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', r.rental_date)::date AS activity_month,
        COUNT(*) AS total_rental_count,
        SUM(
            COALESCE(r.rental_fee, 0)
            + COALESCE(r.late_fee, 0)
        ) AS revenue_generated
    FROM bronze.rental r

    JOIN bronze.inventory_item i
      ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id

    WHERE i.content_id IS NOT NULL
      AND r.rental_date IS NOT NULL

    GROUP BY
        i.content_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', r.rental_date)::date
),

ratings AS (
    SELECT
        content_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', review_date)::date AS activity_month,
        AVG(rating)::numeric(5,2)
            AS average_customer_rating
    FROM bronze.review
    WHERE content_id IS NOT NULL
      AND review_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        content_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', review_date)::date
),

wishlist AS (
    SELECT
        content_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', added_date)::date AS activity_month,
        COUNT(*) AS wishlist_additions
    FROM bronze.wishlist
    WHERE content_id IS NOT NULL
      AND added_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        content_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', added_date)::date
),

latest_content AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (content_id)
        content_id,
        content_type_id
    FROM bronze.content
    WHERE content_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY content_id, ingestion_time DESC
),

primary_genre AS (
    SELECT
        content_id,
        MIN(genre_id) AS genre_id
    FROM bronze.content_genre
    GROUP BY content_id
)

SELECT
    dc.content_key,
    dm.month_key,
    dct.content_type_key,
    dg.genre_key,

    COALESCE(s.total_streams, 0)::int
        AS total_streams,

    COALESCE(r.total_rental_count, 0)::int
        AS total_rental_count,

    COALESCE(r.revenue_generated, 0)::numeric(14,2)
        AS revenue_generated,

    ra.average_customer_rating,

    COALESCE(w.wishlist_additions, 0)::int
        AS wishlist_additions

FROM activity_months a

JOIN gold.dim_content dc
  ON dc.content_id = a.content_id

JOIN gold.dim_month dm
  ON dm.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.activity_month)::int
 AND dm.month = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM a.activity_month)::int

LEFT JOIN latest_content lc
  ON lc.content_id = a.content_id

LEFT JOIN gold.dim_content_type dct
  ON dct.content_type_id = lc.content_type_id

LEFT JOIN primary_genre pg
  ON pg.content_id = a.content_id

LEFT JOIN gold.dim_genre dg
  ON dg.genre_id = pg.genre_id

LEFT JOIN streams s
  ON s.content_id = a.content_id
 AND s.activity_month = a.activity_month

LEFT JOIN rentals r
  ON r.content_id = a.content_id
 AND r.activity_month = a.activity_month

LEFT JOIN ratings ra
  ON ra.content_id = a.content_id
 AND ra.activity_month = a.activity_month

LEFT JOIN wishlist w
  ON w.content_id = a.content_id
 AND w.activity_month = a.activity_month

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM gold.fact_content_monthly_performance f
    WHERE f.content_key = dc.content_key
      AND f.month_key = dm.month_key
);
